items.difficulty_reason: 58 行（含 11 行陈述）、四段归约链完整证明：逐点消灭元函数局部常值化给出一致挠级数，开闭像替换使 n 在 S 上可逆，Z[1/n] 上 Noetherian 下降（f 与 F 分别经 Limits 引理与局部常值层 colimit 引理下降），终以 constructible + specialization 同构 + 局部常值判据收口。全链无 omit、每步具名引理。

primary.label: author proposition environment with its own label proposition-loc-cst-torsion (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5002-5012

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: reduce to affine S; make the torsion degree uniform: the pointwise annihilator function is locally constant with finitely many values (trivializing finite etale cover), giving an open and closed decomposition of X; replace S by the open and closed image of f so n becomes invertible on S; descend to Noetherian base over Z[1/n] by finite presentation descent of f, improvement of f_i, and descent of F through the colimit description of locally constant sheaves with the n-torsion replacement Ker(n); conclude with constructibility from theorem-constructible-shriek, isomorphic specialization maps, and the locally constant characterization (source lines 5014-5071)
